title: Child discloses precise live location to the backend
description: By transmitting live GPS coordinates at regular intervals, the child reveals highly sensitive location data. This enables inference of current whereabouts and movement patterns from the act of sharing itself.

assumptions: The backend or an observer can correlate successive updates by timing, network/session metadata, or trajectory continuity.
uncertainty_note: Tree-node id is approximate; retrieved context only confirmed that Linkability is applicable to ExternalEntity->Process flows.
